1.why: rumor/dilemma/bargain/delay share no dimension - four unrelated nouns, nothing to rank without the stem.

2.why: unread/misquoted/contested are all negative fates for a text; celebrated is the lone positive-valence outlier.

3.why: calculated/sincere/habitual all name an act's origin and uncomfortable names a feeling, but the cluster is too loose to call a centre.

4.why: cautious/exact/typical sit on an accuracy axis and flattering is off it, but only weakly.

5.why: disputed/understated/unpublished are status-of-a-figure words; rounded is the one concrete numeric operation.

6.why: impatient/hesitant/mechanical describe manner while lengthy describes duration - a weak dimension split.

7.why: sponsor/rival/judge are contest roles and witness is an observer, but judge is also legal so the cluster does not close.

8.why: basic/costly/recent/formal share no axis at all.

9.why: escort is physically odd against praise/provoke/imitate, but those three are not synonyms, so no centre is named.

10.why: four parallel adverb+participle phrases on four different dimensions; only poorly timed carries negative valence, which is too thin.

11.why: polite/curious/hopeful are all open, outgoing positives; guarded is the single valence-and-stance outlier.

12.why: eager to please/slow to anger/quick to recover are all temperament phrases; hard to find is availability - the one off-dimension member.

13.why: location/quality/timing are controllable attributes and luck is not, but the set is small enough that the split may be incidental.

14.why: timid/surly/idle are dispositions of bearing; boastful is about speech, a weak outlier.

15.why: postpone/hasten form an antonym pair with record and approve unrelated - a two-two split that points nowhere.

16.why: anxious/weary are states and rude is social; evasive is the only communicative strategy, but the grouping is loose.

17.why: tangled/faded/soaked are all things that happen to a thing unattended; trimmed is the only deliberate human act - agency outlier.

18.why: sluggish/anxious/forgetful read as a symptom cluster and talkative is outside it, but the cluster is thematic rather than synonymous.

19.why: patient/humble/willing are all character dispositions; skillful is the lone capability term - different dimension entirely.

20.why: fundamentals/strategy/conditioning are abstract training mass-nouns; scrimmages is a countable concrete activity - different level of specificity.

21.why: recall/perform/explain are demonstrable acts and doubt is an attitude, but three verbs this varied do not name a centre.

22.why: experimental/conventional, impersonal/intimate and austere/lavish are three clean antonym pairs; hurried/polished is the one asymmetric pairing.

23.why: confusion/exhaustion/poverty are unambiguously bad while solitude can be neutral, which is too weak to be structural.

24.why: costly/widespread/brief all scale a real effect; harmless is the lone valence outlier that negates the effect.

25.why: confusing/costly/permanent are three negatives; profitable is the single positive-valence outlier.

26.why: wilted/scorched/overgrown are all conditions a neglected plant falls into; repotted is the only deliberate gardener action - same agency outlier as item 17.

27.why: coincidence/misunderstanding are accidental and routine/precaution intentional - a two-two split with no outlier.

28.why: deep/recent/local are extent dimensions and fragile is a material quality, but the axis is not named by the set.

29.why: provisional/outdated/unofficial are three near-synonyms for 'not the authoritative version' and cannot all be right; illegible is the centre they point away from.

30.why: only short...extend is an internally coherent problem-remedy pair; difficult/plan, clear/abandon and familiar/describe have no relation between the blanks.
